name: qflow
description: QFlow – Smart Virtual Queue Management System (MERN Stack with Real-time Socket.IO)

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm run build --prefix frontend

author: QFlow Team
